audience: editors and content teams who manage posts, pages and comments on one WordPress site

useCases.title: Find drafts and pending posts
useCases.text: List the posts with status draft or pending. Open one post to read its full content, categories and tags.

useCases.title: Review pages, categories and tags
useCases.text: List the pages of the site with their parent and link. List the categories and tags with their post counts.

useCases.title: Check comments waiting for review
useCases.text: List the comments on hold, or the comments of one post. Read them before you decide whether to approve them.

useCases.title: Write a draft post
useCases.text: Create a post saved as a draft. The tool never publishes it. Publishing a draft stays in wp-admin.

useCases.title: Update a post's fields
useCases.text: Change the fields you pass on an existing post. If the post is already published, the change goes live at once.

useCases.title: Approve or mark comments as spam
useCases.text: Set a comment's status to approve, hold or spam. This tool never deletes or trashes a comment.
